questions.question: You are building a customer support chat app. Every response must use a polite tone and be no longer than three sentences, regardless of what the user asks. Where should you specify these requirements?

options.text: In the system prompt
options.why: Correct. The system prompt sets persistent rules, tone and format for every turn.

options.text: In each user prompt
options.why: Users write user prompts, and rules there are not reliably applied to every turn.

options.text: In the assistant message history
options.why: Assistant messages are previous model replies, not instructions.

options.text: In the deployment name
options.why: The deployment name only identifies the deployment.

questions.explanation: System prompts define the model's role, rules, tone and output format for the whole conversation.

questions.scenario: A model generates product descriptions in an inconsistent structure. You need every description to follow the same three-bullet format.
questions.question: Which prompt technique is most likely to produce consistent output?

options.text: Increase the temperature
options.why: A higher temperature increases variation, which makes the format less consistent.

options.text: Include two or three examples of correctly formatted descriptions in the prompt
options.why: Correct. Few-shot examples show the model the exact pattern to follow.

options.text: Remove the system prompt
options.why: Removing instructions makes the output less predictable.

options.text: Ask the user to rephrase the request
options.why: This places the burden on the user and does not fix the format.

questions.explanation: Few-shot prompting provides sample inputs and outputs so that the model reproduces the desired structure.

questions.question: A company's HR assistant sometimes invents leave policy details. Which TWO prompt changes help ensure that answers are based on the company's actual policy?

options.text: Include the policy text in the prompt, separated by delimiters
options.why: Correct. Grounding data inside clear delimiters gives the model the facts to use.

options.text: Instruct the model to answer only from the supplied policy and to state when the answer is not available
options.why: Correct. This instruction limits answers to the grounding data.

options.text: Ask the model to be more creative
options.why: Encouraging creativity increases the risk of invented details.

options.text: Remove the instruction about the assistant's role
options.why: Removing the role does not address made-up facts.

questions.explanation: Grounding the model with relevant data and instructing it to answer only from that data reduces fabricated answers.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of using delimiters, such as triple quotes or XML-style tags, in a prompt?

options.text: To reduce the cost of each request
options.why: Delimiters add a few tokens and do not reduce cost.

options.text: To separate instructions from the content that the model should process
options.why: Correct. Delimiters mark where supplied content begins and ends.

options.text: To encrypt the prompt before it is sent
options.why: Delimiters are plain text and provide no encryption.

options.text: To select a different model deployment
options.why: Deployments are selected by name in the request, not by delimiters.

questions.explanation: Delimiters help the model distinguish instructions from data, which improves accuracy and reduces confusion.

questions.question: You need a generative AI app to decline requests that are unrelated to your product and to refuse harmful requests. Which prompt element should you add, in addition to enabling guardrails?

options.text: A safety system message
options.why: Correct. A safety system message defines what the model must refuse and how to stay on topic.

options.text: A higher max output tokens value
options.why: Longer output does not affect refusals.

options.text: A stop sequence
options.why: Stop sequences end generation at specific text; they do not define refusal behavior.

options.text: A user prompt template
options.why: User prompts come from users and cannot be relied on for safety rules.

questions.explanation: A safety system message sets refusal and scope rules in the system prompt. It complements content filters and Prompt Shields.
